listing.name: PR to Green
listing.tagline: Drive a pull request until CI is green and review approves
listing.description: A goal loop: fix findings, push, re-check, repeat.

data.exitCondition: All checks pass and the latest review is APPROVED
data.goal: The PR has a fresh approval, green CI, and is mergeable
data.kickoff:
Run the pr-to-green loop on the open PR:
1. Read every review finding.
2. Fix the valid ones, push back on the invalid.
3. Push and re-check until green.
